findings.title: Improvement rollback remediation has no transaction that releases its rollback-safety blocks
findings.requirement: Rollback-safety exposure/resource blocks must remain through genuine restoration and independent verification, then be removed by an exact named transition before cleanup or terminality.
evidence: PLAN.md §13 (line 329) and §16 cleanup prose (line 415) name only B38/M29 as rollback-safety block-removal transactions after stating that B37/M28/IRB06 can create those obligations.
Manifest §13.1 RO09 (line 656) retains rollback-safety blocks for B74/B34/B38 or M62/M25/M29, and the closing contract (line 663) again says only B38/M29 remove them.
The improvement chain IRB06 -> RO09 -> IRB09 -> IRB03 -> IRB07-N/R/Q has no block-removal effect. IRB08, IR13C-X, and IX03 only schedule cleanup after ROLLED_BACK.
findings.impact: A remediated improvement rollback either reaches cleanup while its rollback-safety blocks remain forever, preventing full resource release and terminality, or an implementation invents an unauthored unblock. Letting RO09 release them would recreate the unsafe pre-verification release that round 11 intended to remove.
findings.required_correction: Add an exact IMPROVEMENT block-removal transaction after IRB03 independent verification, preferably atomically in IRB07-N/R/Q while sealing ROLLED_BACK. Align PLAN §13, RO09/§13.1 prose, IRB rows, cleanup/terminal guards, and witnesses.

findings.title: Active digest invalidation can strand EVIDENCE_STALE in an Effect reconciliation rollout
findings.requirement: Every active-rollout digest change must fence first and then complete the X/N/UNSETTLED partition to rollback or no-exposure cleanup without an undefined edge.
evidence: Manifest IC24-A (line 775) changes candidate SHADOW_PASSED -> EVIDENCE_STALE and, for UNSETTLED, preserves the original Effect in WIDENING_RECONCILING or PROMOTION_RECONCILING.

After settlement, IC32-RWX/RPX/RN require candidate REVOKED; IC32-HWX/HPX/HN require SHADOW_PASSED; IH06-* require control-health degradation. None accepts EVIDENCE_STALE solely to finish IC24-A reconciliation.
IC32-E requires a separate revocation event. IC25-IC27 refresh the candidate but do not settle the active reconciliation rollout.
findings.impact: A digest change racing an unsettled widening or promotion Effect can remain permanently BLOCKED after the Effect becomes classifiable unless an unrelated revocation arrives or an implementation invents an edge. The claimed IC24-A X/N/UNSETTLED totality is not executable as a closed manifest.
findings.required_correction: Add exact EVIDENCE_STALE reconciliation-continuation rows for widening and promotion X and N outcomes. Preserve Effect identity, create or reuse at most one rollback for X, use exactly one cleanup owner for N, and add digest-change-before-settlement witnesses through both outcomes.
